items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: The CLI covers every WebUI transition, show, JSON state, and stable exits without changing the WebUI.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Usage, CAS, missing id/store, and lock timeout are typed and mapped to documented exits.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Optional input remains sanitized; no credentials or privilege boundaries were added.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Subprocess tests cover success, failures, an injected timeout, deterministic CAS race, and no-write validation failures.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: The change reuses the existing lock and resolver without a service, polling loop, or new unbounded scan.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: The argparse module stays thin and the handler split follows the existing repository convention.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: CLI JSON stdout is compared against the on-disk resolver result after each write and after an amend overlay.
